title: really helpful  but..
body: it’s really helpful but it would be better if you could set timers for at least 3 different hours since i do my habit (Exercise) three times a day at different times
author: Elena123;

title: Best of its kind
body:
I don’t regret paying for this, it’s exceed my expectations, it’s simple to use, nice interface, only does what it was intended, tracking habits, and the best, only one lifetime payment, you’ll pay double in a year for some other similar apps. 

Keep working hard 💪😎.
author: jeremymolina

title: Muy buen app
body: El app es genial y cumple lo que promete el precio me parece un poco elevado eso sí, me gustaría que los hábitos se pudieran ordenar cronológicamente
